# External benchmark results

Generated by `python -m evals.external run --write`. Rules: [PLAN.md](../PLAN.md); findings: [REPORT.md](../REPORT.md). Brackets are 95% bootstrap intervals over questions; differences are paired. Every search is `search(question, k=10)` with defaults; no LLM is involved.

## Mode A: retrieval on flat cards

`card` scores the ranked cards against the cards holding an evidence turn; `session` scores the ranked cards' sessions (first occurrence) against the evidence sessions. Pooled rows exclude unanswerable questions (LongMemEval abstention, LoCoMo adversarial) and MEME's before-change questions.

## Abstention: do `coverage` and `unmatched_terms` separate unanswerable questions?

AUROC = probability that a random answerable question scores higher than a random unanswerable one (0.5 = no separation). `coverage_max` is the best `coverage` on the first page; `matched share` is 1 − (unmatched query words / query words). MEME's Absence and Deletion questions are answerable lexically by design; that row shows what lexical signals can't see.

| Corpus | Answerable | Unanswerable | AUROC coverage_max | AUROC matched share | Any unmatched (ans / unans) | Mean coverage_max (ans / unans) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| longmemeval-s/round | 470 | 30 | 0.671 [0.564, 0.770] | 0.688 [0.598, 0.777] | 0.068 / 0.433 | 0.641 / 0.541 |
| longmemeval-s/session | 470 | 30 | 0.669 [0.552, 0.784] | 0.688 [0.598, 0.777] | 0.068 / 0.433 | 0.756 / 0.645 |
| locomo/turn | 1540 | 446 | 0.512 [0.481, 0.541] | 0.553 [0.528, 0.577] | 0.231 / 0.345 | 0.524 / 0.519 |
| locomo/session | 1540 | 446 | 0.547 [0.517, 0.575] | 0.553 [0.528, 0.577] | 0.231 / 0.345 | 0.722 / 0.688 |
| meme-filler32k/round | 464 | 230 | 0.218 [0.187, 0.252] | 0.285 [0.259, 0.312] | 0.478 / 0.039 | 0.578 / 0.786 |

## Mode B: lineage versus flat cards (same cards, same questions)

`stale@10`: an outdated fact is on the first page unwarned. `stale-first`: it ranks above every current card. `current@10`: share of current-value cards on the page. `value-leak@10` (Deletion): some card other than the deletion request still states the deleted value. `history@10` (Tracking): share of the value history among results; `history-named@10` also counts `matched_via_superseded` entries.

| Group | n | Metric | Flat | Lineage | Lineage − flat |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| longmemeval-s/knowledge-update | 70 | current@10 | 0.957 [0.914, 1.000] | 1.000 [1.000, 1.000] | 0.043 [0.000, 0.086] |
| longmemeval-s/knowledge-update | 70 | stale-first | 0.586 [0.471, 0.700] | 0.000 [0.000, 0.000] | -0.586 [-0.700, -0.471] |
| longmemeval-s/knowledge-update | 70 | stale@10 | 0.971 [0.929, 1.000] | 0.000 [0.000, 0.000] | -0.971 [-1.000, -0.929] |

## Where lexical search misses (flat, card level, answerable; exploratory)

A query word is *distinctive* when fewer than 10% of the haystack's cards contain it. `vocabulary gap`: no judged card contains any of the question's distinctive words. `outranked`: one does, but ten other cards rank higher. This reading was defined after run 1 (PLAN.md ledger).
